replies.if_they_say: How much does the lead sheet cost?
replies.reply: Thanks for messaging! The pricing depends on the target area and volume, and you pay only after you approve the work. Quick question: what service do you sell, and which city are you targeting?

replies.if_they_say: Will this list work for my specific service?
replies.reply: Yes, it pulls local businesses from Google Places with phone numbers, review counts, and website status, so it works whatever you sell—design, ads, video, or accounts. What service are you pitching right now?

replies.if_they_say: Can you send a sample sheet or demo?
replies.reply: I don't keep static sample files since business data changes constantly. I can explain the exact structure and check availability for your target location. Which business category and city are you planning to reach?
